t: Smith & Locke endless ratchet tie-down straps keep light loads secure during transport and storage. This 2-pack offers 5m straps with weather-resistant polyester webbing reinforced with stitching, standing up to rain, sun and site conditions without degrading. The quick-release ratchet tightens or loosens loads in seconds—no fumbling with knots or excess strap to manage. Each strap handles 250kg lashing capacity with 500kg minimum breaking strength, making them reliable for securing equipment on vans, trailers and shelving. Simple, effective and built to last.
